The program

Cable Technician Training Program

A 4-week, hands-on program that builds the practical skills to become a professional cable technician in telecommunications and data centers.

Home / Program
Program overview

Learn the trade with your hands.

Are you interested in starting a career in telecommunications and data centers? The Cable Technician Training Program gives you the practical, hands-on skills needed to become a professional technician — whether you are brand new or changing careers.

  • 4 weeks · morning and evening classes
  • Hands-on lab exercises with professional instruction
  • No experience required
  • Certificate of Completion
  • Resume, interview and job search help
Reserve your seat
What you will learn

The curriculum

Tap any topic to see what it covers.

01

Structured cabling

Cat5e, Cat6 and fiber optic cabling.

02

Cable pulling, routing & labeling

Pulling, routing, management and professional labeling.

03

Rack & stack installation

Building racks, mounting equipment, installing patch panels and terminating keystone jacks.

04

Termination & testing

RJ45 termination, fiber optic basics and cable testing with professional tools.

05

Networking fundamentals

Basic networking and reading floor plans and drawings.

06

Safety & professional habits

Data center safety practices, tool identification and professional work habits.

Hands-on practice includes

Real tasks, real tools.

  • Installing and terminating network cables
  • Building and organizing server racks
  • Installing patch panels and testing cables with professional tools
  • Troubleshooting basic network issues
Program features & career support

Help beyond the classroom.

  • Hands-on lab exercises and professional instruction
  • Certificate of Completion
  • Resume assistance
  • Interview preparation
  • Job search guidance in the DMV area

Graduates receive a Certificate of Completion from Data Center Tech Academy DMV. It is not an industry certification.

Potential career roles

Where this program can take you.

Upon completion, you will be prepared for entry-level roles such as:

Cable TechnicianStructured Cabling InstallerLow Voltage TechnicianData Center TechnicianNetwork Cabling TechnicianFiber Optic Technician
Who should attend

Open to everyone.

Beginners with no experienceCareer changersHigh school graduatesReturning citizensAnyone looking for a high-demand career
